preconditions.description: The number of vertices in each test case is between 2 and 2 * 10^5.

preconditions.description: The number of edges in each test case is between 1 and 2 * 10^5.

preconditions.description: The start and end vertices are between 1 and n, and they are not the same.

preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.split('\n')[2::3]]) <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of the number of vertices across all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

preconditions.description: The sum of the number of edges across all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) and 0 <= result < 10**9 + 7 for result in [int(line) for line in stdout.split('\n')])
postconditions.description: Each result is a non-negative integer less than 10^9 + 7.
The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.
